evidence: The machine features an inline transparent bin with yellow cyclones and clearly readable 'dyson v15 detect' branding printed on the wand.

candidate_checks.evidence: The machine exhibits full-size V15 body proportions and readable 'dyson v15 detect' text on the wand.
The inline body, yellow radial cyclones, and clear 'dyson v15 detect' wand identifier confirm this model.
The inline dustbin contradicts the perpendicular dustbin configuration of the V8 family.
The cordless stick configuration contradicts the wheeled canister design of the Big Ball.
The standard inline bin and 'dyson v15 detect' labeling contradict the V16 Piston Animal design.
The cyclone stick vacuum layout contradicts the upright dual-tank wet-cleaning layout of the WashG1.
